chunks: And Hishām ibn Sālim narrated from him, peace be upon him, that he said:
Regarding a man who performs the salat (prayer) alone and then finds a congregation, he said: “He may pray with them and count it as the obligatory prayer, if he wishes.”
ai.seo_question: If someone prays alone and then finds a congregational prayer, may he pray again with the congregation and count it as the obligatory prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who has prayed alone and then comes upon a congregational prayer. It permits him to pray with the congregation and to treat that prayer as his obligatory salat (prayer), if he wishes.
